description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Product Viewed' report extension within the OpenCart admin controller namespace. It manages report viewing, saving settings, installation, uninstallation, and generating report data related to viewed products.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Product Viewed' report extension, handling report display, data generation, and settings management within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main view for the product viewed report, setting up breadcrumbs and page titles.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of report configuration settings, including permission checks and storing settings into the database.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for the report extension, invoking the model method to set up necessary data.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process, invoking the model method to remove the extension data.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the report overview page with report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report data as a view, typically for AJAX calls.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the detailed report data as a JSON string, involving pagination, data retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates report data; can be called to update or create report entries.
